## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature request.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Testing

- [ ] Verified build succeeds with `cargo check` and `cargo build --release`
- [ ] Formatted using `cargo fmt`
- [ ] Tested audio playback and auto-reconnect on a physical Windows device

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new compiler warnings
